item.title: Manatee County Commission to honor the late Carol Ann Felts
item.description: The Manatee County Commission will honor Carol Ann Felts at its Tuesday meeting, after the 68 year old, who represented District 1, passed away suddenly last week.

item.title: Federal, local officials say Texas bar shooter was not on their radar
item.description: A gunman wearing clothes with an Iranian flag design and the words “Property of Allah” killed two people and wounded 14 early Sunday at a Texas bar, a law enforcement official told The Associated Press. The FBI is investigating the shooting, which erupted a day after the U.S. and Israel launched an attack on Iran, as a potential act of terrorism.

item.title: 14,000 gallons of wastewater spills into Sarasota Bay
item.description: 14,000 gallons of raw wastewater spilled into Sarasota Bay on Sunday at West John Ringling Causeway Park.

item.title: 'Giving thanks to God': Tampa Bay honeymooners flee Middle East after war breaks out
item.description: The trip of a Brandon couple's dreams turned into a nightmare this weekend as they had to flee the Middle East during their honeymoon. It took Gisselle Lopez and Christian Lugo two days to get out of Abu Dhabi; they told 8 On Your Side they spent every hour fearing for their lives.

item.title: Sarasota to investigate remedies to neighborhood dust issue, including public nuisance action
item.description: Several residents of Sarasota's Central Cocoanut neighborhood spoke during Monday's city commission meeting, expressing their ongoing concerns about the industrial concrete crushing and recycling facility near their homes.
